name: Object detection + pose on the overhead camera (second instance of T2_detect)

provenance.notes: NPU part: onnx_graph_walk of the real exported graph (263 ONNX nodes, 30 metadata nodes dropped, 114 activations fused, 111 ops kept). dtype int8 is a deployment assumption (W8A8, int32 bias); the export itself is fp32. Layers follow ultralytics module index (model.N), Detect head split per branch. CPU post-processing is analytic_count with assumptions: 200 pre-NMS candidates, 8 objects, 3600 depth px per crop, 5 ICP iterations. Output [1, 84, 8400]. This file is a renamed copy of T2_detect for the overhead camera (scenario S2).

ops.notes: dequantize int8 head output, per-anchor class max over 80 classes, confidence threshold; 8400 anchors
sort 200 candidates then greedy NMS, worst case K^2/2 IoU tests at ~15 flops each
per object: deproject 3600 depth px, centroid+PCA (3x3 covariance, Jacobi eigen), 5 ICP iterations at ~60 flops/point; 8 objects
